description:
## Problem

`OrderedSet::remove` removes membership from its `HashSet` and then scans the entire insertion-order `Vec` with `retain`.

`DependencyIndex::replace_reads` and `replace_waits` remove every previous membership and reinsert every next membership, including memberships present in both sets. Therefore, if one fact has fan-out F and all F participants complete again with that dependency unchanged, replacement performs Θ(F²) ordered-vector scans.

`Scheduler::complete` calls `replace_waits` for every completion. `replace_reads` is called for concluded derivations; blocked/unreached derivations use `union_reads`. `forget_reads` also pays the linear removal cost for genuine withdrawals.

This ticket is about subscriber/waiter membership. Although `OrderedSet` also stores output order, current output replacement/rebuild paths do not call `OrderedSet::remove`.

## Reproducer

Against origin/main a3a9761d, register N jobs reading or waiting on one fact, then call `replace_reads` or `replace_waits` again for every job with the same singleton set.

| fan-out | unchanged reads | unchanged waits |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1,000 | 0.491 ms | 0.421 ms |
| 2,000 | 1.683 ms | 1.379 ms |
| 4,000 | 6.183 ms | 4.798 ms |
| 8,000 | 23.773 ms | 18.366 ms |
| 16,000 | 93.910 ms | 71.292 ms |

Near-4× growth per doubling confirms the quadratic shape. This synthetic result does not establish material cost on current workloads.

## Goal

Make dependency replacement proportional to changed memberships, or establish with representative workload measurements that current fan-out/removal cost is immaterial. Preserve deterministic insertion order: a continuously registered member must not move merely because an unchanged dependency set was reported again.

## Signal and strategy

- Add red dependency-index tests showing unchanged read/wait replacement preserves subscriber/waiter order.
- Measure maximum fan-out, removal counts, and attributable time across fixture matrix/library suite; remove probes afterward.
- First diff previous/next sets so only withdrawals are removed and only introductions inserted. This eliminates unchanged-edge churn and preserves continuous order.
- If genuine removals remain material, use an order-preserving indexed or tombstone/compaction representation; swap-remove is invalid.
- Preserve scheduler determinism/canonical output.
- Document `OrderedSet::remove` complexity and why Agenda differs (`VecDeque::pop_front`).
- Focused tests, full library, fixture matrix, formatting, workspace checks, and strict clippy pass.
title: [PERF] Dependency subscription replacement is quadratic under shared-fact fan-out
